notes: Two branches (ح) meet at حكيم بن جابر; the Companion «عبادة بن الصامت» is written once after the last ح, so it is the shared tail (rule 3)
«قال قال إسماعيل» : Abu Usama reports Isma'il's words, so Isma'il is a link
«ولم يذكر يعقوب الكفة بالكفة» is a wording variant and is left out; Mu'awiya's remark inside the story is not a link
